title: Synthetic Data Lifecycle
summary: A synthetic-data generation research project with a cross-domain benchmarking extension that trains and evaluates multiple generative models (CTGAN, TVAE, DP-CTGAN) across datasets, tracking metrics like fairness and utility. It calls SDV's single-table API (SingleTableMetadata, TVAESynthesizer) alongside the standalone ctgan package to fit and sample synthetic data as part of its benchmark pipeline.
